what: Every tell named in AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, docs/HUMANIZATION-GATE.md, tools/humanization/TELLS-FROM-PANGRAM-DATA-20261007.md and tools/humanization/JOEL-FIXES-CATALOGUE-20260928.md, from the coverage audit of 2026-10-11 (tools/humanization/TELLS-COVERAGE-20261011.md). A mechanical tell names the rule in tells_lint.py that checks it and an example paragraph that triggers that rule; a judgment tell says why it needs a reader. Each quote is in its file once whitespace is collapsed and curly quotes are made straight. tests/test_tells_registry.py checks every quote and runs every example. A tell added to one of those files gets an entry here in the same change.

fields.id: W for a tell a pattern or a count can find, J for one that needs a reader (the audit's numbering)
fields.tell: the tell, in the documents' words
fields.sources: where the documents name it: the file, and a quote from it
fields.rule: mechanical: the tells_lint.py rule that flags it
fields.example: mechanical: a short paragraph that should get that flag
fields.source_text: W77 only: the source section the example is compared with (D9 needs --source)
fields.requires: a package the rule needs; the test skips the example without it
fields.reason: judgment: why no pattern can decide it
